children: NeOnc reported senior executives purchased about $629,000 of shares following positive NEO100 Phase 2a results, including CEO purchases totaling 111,000 shares.
CEO Amir Heshmatpour bought an additional 35,000 shares on Sept 15 for ~$115,400 at ~$3.30/share.
Since Aug 12 Phase 2a top-line results, Heshmatpour bought 111,000 shares for ~$418,700 (avg ~$3.77/share).
CMO Thomas C. Chen purchased 49,016 shares for ~ $210,000; combined insider buys total 160,016 shares (~$629,000).
Purchases follow a $15M registered direct offering and positive NEO100 Phase 2a topline showing vs. 20% benchmark.
NEO100 Phase 2a reported 6-month PFS 48.9% (p=0.0047) and median OS 26.09 months; NEO212 completed Phase 1 dose escalation.
